data.description: task: {title, start, end, all_day, location, text, category, calendar, tags} — timed: start and end as 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM'; all_day=true: start and end as 'YYYY-MM-DD', end = last day (inclusive, may be omitted for one day). contact: {name, fields: {field name: value}, tags} — name defaults to first and last name. note: {title, tab_name, text, note_tree, tags}. todo: {title, todo_list, start, end, text, tags}.
